column1: # DMN counters (.dmn of DMN 1.1 to 1.5: Camunda 7 and 8, Flowable, Drools, Kogito, Trisotech): the
# counters of xml-facts, its [ignore] line included, then a second [ignore] line that blanks the
# diagram interchange (DMNDI: shapes, edges, waypoints), which is layout, not logic, and one counter
# per decision element, with or without a namespace prefix. "inputs" and "outputs" are the columns of
# the decision tables (<input>, <output>, not <inputData>, <inputEntry> or <outputEntry>), "rules" their
# rows; "decision tables with a hit policy other than UNIQUE" counts a hitPolicy attribute that sets
# FIRST, ANY, PRIORITY, COLLECT, RULE ORDER or OUTPUT ORDER (UNIQUE is the default and needs none).
# "requirements" counts the information, knowledge and authority requirements of the decision
# requirements graph. A DMNDI section that is never closed runs to the end of the file.
# EnterpriseXmlFactPatternsTest pins every case; ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every
decision tables with a hit policy other than UNIQUE
boxed contexts, invocations, relations and functions
